input.quote: This Agreement shall be automatically renewed for an additional one year period on each anniversary of the Effective Date, unless terminated by either Party hereto upon ninety (90) days written notice to the other.
input.rationale: Section 4.1 provides one-year automatic renewals (acceptable term length) but requires ninety (90) days' written notice to stop a renewal. That exceeds the fallback ceiling of a 60-day non-renewal notice window, so it fails the fallback on a material term, though it stops short of walk-away territory (windows longer than 90 days or multi-year auto-renewals). We therefore propose the minimal edit to the preferred 30-day window, with the 60-day fallback offered in the comment. No renewal price-uplift language appears anywhere in the Agreement, and the absence of a vendor renewal reminder is a minor sub-element noted here rather than flagged.

ops.oldText: unless terminated by either Party hereto upon ninety (90) days written notice to the other
ops.newText: unless terminated by either Party hereto upon thirty (30) days written notice to the other

proposal.comment: [Playbook] We shortened the non-renewal notice window from ninety to thirty days so either party can exit an automatic renewal on reasonable notice, consistent with our position that renewals stay easy to exit; we can live with sixty days if that is easier for you.
proposal.summary: Shorten the non-renewal notice window in Section 4.1 from 90 days to 30 days.
